{{Quote|We've got two wings of X- and Y-wings available during that time ''[&hellip;]'' Sector Command says they can scrape up two more&mdash;''"<br />"''Probably. We've got the fighters who survived the Tocan system disaster recuperating in Ghorman; they'll be maybe 75% effective in two weeks.|Rebel Alliance [[Chief of Starfighter Command (Alliance)|Chief of Starfighter Command]] and [[Chief of Sector Command]]|<ref name="AHC2">{{WEGCite|story=Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
The '''Tocan system''' was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]], including "[[Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command]]," is set before the beginning of {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> it was the site of what was later referred to by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as the "[[Tocan system disaster]]," an engagement between the Alliance and the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in which the former lost a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]&mdash;with the survivors subsequently recuperating in<ref name="AHC2" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Ghorman system/Legends|Ghorman system]]&mdash;and after which the latter's [[Tierfon Sector Fleet]] similarly required rest and refit.<ref name="AHC2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tocan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in "[[Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Paul Murphy]] and published in [[1990]] for use with [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AHC1">{{WEGCite|story=Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
